public_rationale: The ordinary graph-based reading is supported. Mythos's fitted 80% horizon was about 3.1 hours, substantially below the suite's 16-hour reliable measurement limit. The same fitted curve implies a shorter horizon at 95%, leaving more room on the existing task-duration scale. This supports the comparative headroom claim, but does not establish how many individual tasks remain below either reliability threshold. The figures and method come from [METR's results](https://metr.org/time-horizons/).
limitations: Support depends on reading headroom as room on the fitted horizon scale.
The calculated 95% value is illustrative and lacks a validated uncertainty interval.
Results concern an early Mythos Preview checkpoint, not every subsequent version.
